ideas.pitch: A real-time modular state switcher designed to handle sudden mid-hackathon rule changes and twist challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: Devlympics: 24 Hours. One Theme. Endless Possibilities. Anticipating unexpected challenges and creative constraints.
ideas.title: ChaosAdapter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core evaluation metric of how well teams adapt to sudden challenges and creative constraints during the event.

ideas.pitch: A rapid-prototyping assistant optimized for 24-hour sprints that auto-generates UI components from rough whiteboard sketches.
ideas.problem_statement: Devlympics: 24 Hours. One Theme. Endless Possibilities. Starting from zero with an open-ended theme under a strict 24-hour clock.
ideas.title: ChronoCraft AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emphasizes extreme execution speed and a demo that actually works live under tight time constraints.

ideas.pitch: An immersive spatial computing experiment that projects live theme hints and constraint timers into physical space via device cameras.
ideas.problem_statement: Devlympics: 24 Hours. One Theme. Endless Possibilities. Open-ended theme interpretation and hardware/interactive experience potential.
ideas.title: ZeroLag AR Theme Injector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the open-ended nature of the theme and stands out through a flashy, physical live demo that judges remember.

ideas.pitch: A peer-to-peer decentralized collaboration canvas for multi-disciplinary hackathon teams to bypass local network limits.
ideas.problem_statement: Devlympics: 24 Hours. One Theme. Endless Possibilities. Collaboration and coordination under high pressure.
ideas.title: SyncMesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases genuinely hard engineering by implementing local-first distributed synchronization within a 24-hour window.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first emergency fallback system using IoT sensors to trigger alerts when venue constraints or internet drops happen.
ideas.problem_statement: Devlympics: 24 Hours. One Theme. Endless Possibilities. Building hardware experiments or unexpected robust systems under pressure.
ideas.title: EdgePanic
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hardware and software elements to address the chaotic nature of live hackathon environments.
